name: Hacker News Search API (Algolia)
publisher: Algolia, on behalf of Y Combinator
description: Full-text search over every Hacker News story and comment since 2007, with points, comment counts, authors and timestamps, as JSON with no key. A convenient corpus for measuring technology attention, and the fastest way to find the discussion thread about anything.

license.name: unspecified; the API is public and widely used for research

access.pagination: page= and hitsPerPage= (max 1000); use search_by_date with numericFilters for full walks

recipes.title: Walk every story matching a term, oldest to newest
recipes.code: curl -s 'https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search_by_date?query=tidytuesday&tags=story&hitsPerPage=20' | python3 -c "import json,sys;[print(h['created_at'][:10], h['points'], h['title']) for h in json.load(sys.stdin)['hits']]"

gotchas.trap: /search ranks by relevance and silently caps deep paging; /search_by_date is the one that walks completely.
gotchas.fix: For a full crawl use search_by_date plus numericFilters=created_at_i<last_seen and page backwards in time.
